title: Ledgerproof: consolidated tenant-credit telemetry synthesizer
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Background: Multiple ingestion sources (stream-ingest, session-proxy, edge-collector) currently emit candidate tenant-credit events that are later reconciled by heavy-weight batch jobs. This creates visible latency between when credits are earned and when they appear in console UI or downstream charging systems. Goal: implement a streaming synthesizer (Ledgerproof) that consolidates credit telemetry in near-real-time, produces idempotent provisional credit records with provenance tags, and emits a compact, debuggable delta stream for downstream settlement and audit.

Scope: build a stateful stream job that: 1) consumes canonical usage events, session-level KV cache deltas, and pre-aggregated short-window summaries; 2) normalizes tokens->credit conversions using per-plan rate tables; 3) deduplicates cross-source duplicates using a probabilistic fingerprint + deterministic fallback; 4) attaches provenance metadata (source, sequence, ingest-timestamp, confidence); 5) outputs to ledgerproof-topic and a parallel backfill-ready compact artifact for batch settlement; 6) exposes health metrics and lineage for Console trace links.

Non-goals: this ticket does not perform final invoicing or modify billing ledger schema. The synthesizer produces provisional, explainable deltas intended for downstream adjudicators.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end dev pipeline: pipeline can be run locally with sampled replay data and produces expected deltas for test cases in the spec.
- Correctness: dedupe tests and synthetic late-arrival scenarios show <=0.1% mismatch against golden dataset for target tenants.
- Observability: each emitted record includes provenance fields and a trace_id that links to Grafana/Console traces. Health dashboard panels added showing fanned watermark lag, duplicate-rate, and confidence histogram.
- Autoself-heal: job recovers from transient consumer lag and resumes exactly-once output semantics within configured SLA.
- Documentation: Confluence design doc and runbook exist; README for engineers explains local replay and debug workflows.

Risks and mitigations:
- Out-of-order arrivals can cause provisional double-crediting. Mitigation: deterministic fingerprint + windowed watermarking with explicit late-arrival policy; surfaced as low-confidence records for downstream adjudication.
- High-cardinality tenant state growth. Mitigation: TTL and compacting checkpoints; eviction policy based on recent activity.
- Attribution disagreements with legacy batch: run in shadow mode for 2 weeks before promotion, provide nightly diff reports and an automated replayer to reproduce mismatches.
comments: 2026-02-11 - Kickoff: scoped with PM (Lina Park) and Billing SME (Jonah Rivera). Decided shadow-first rollout and nightly diff report cadence.
2026-02-20 - Design review: Simpler fingerprint chosen (sha256 of session_id+tenant+route) with 24-hour dedupe window. Action: Miguel to prototype fingerprint service and local replay harness.

2026-02-28 - Prototype results: local replay shows 0.06% mismatch vs golden for sample tenants. Noted pathological case where identical tokens from distinct proxies collided; added source_id to fingerprint in fallback path. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledgerproof/pull/42

2026-03-03 - Implementation: initial stream job committed (branch: feat/ledgerproof-stream). Integration tests added.
Follow-up: add metrics for confidence score distribution (prometheus).

2026-03-07 - QA: ran shadow mode on staging for 48h, observed spikes in watermark-lag during region failover test (INC-2026-03-07-1). Root cause: consumer rebalance timeout too aggressive. Fix: increase session timeout and add faster checkpointing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledgerproof/pull/58
2026-03-10 - Review feedback from Security (Amir Shah): require KMS-encrypted state checkpoints in Private deployments. Added optional config flag and documented in runbook.

2026-03-12 - Current: Job running in staged shadow in us-west for selected tenants. Nightly diff report produced; overall delta within expected bounds. Next: schedule cross-team rollout review with Billing to set promotion criteria and SLA for final settlement ingestion.
test_plan: 1) Local replay harness with small golden set. 2) Staging shadow run for 72 hours with nightly diffs. 3) Canary in us-west with 1% production traffic and automated rollback if mismatch >0.5% or duplicate-rate >0.2%. 4) Pre-promotion full replay to certify parity for billing critical tenants.
manual_steps: Deploy stream job to staging: k8s apply -f staging/ledgerproof.yaml
Enable shadow mode toggles via console feature flags and validate nightly diff dashboard
Trigger manual replay for mismatch tenant using replayer CLI and attach trace_id to Jira ticket
owner_notes: Prefer running in Kafka Streams for built-in state stores; evaluate Flink if we need more complex windowing semantics. Keep the output record compact to avoid high egress costs; move large debug blobs to S3 and reference via URL. Coordinate final promotion with Billing team and Platform infra for KMS-enabled checkpoints.
